veo_prompt: Cinematic masterwork 4K video. Expansive tranquil obsidian void (#07020D) with tactile 35mm analog film grain. A precision-cut optical crystal prism rests in deep space. A thin, coherent cyan telemetry beam strikes the prism and refracts smoothly upward into a stable, peaceful horizontal orbit, avoiding a faint red boundary plane below. Soft royal violet (#471485) and fuchsia (#5E0D46) ambient blooms in the far background. Slow cinematic camera glide. Zero text, zero floating coins, zero neon grids, photorealistic architectural polish.
